title: 22. Interview: System design interview checklist
summary: Interview Q&A for System design interview checklist.
objectives: Answer the System design interview checklist interview questions out loud
Lead with the concept, then a small example, then a tradeoff

sections.title: Pre-Interview Preparation Checklist
sections.body:
**Print this and keep it handy during preparation and before interviews!**

### Fundamentals (Week 1)
- [ ] Understand horizontal vs vertical scaling
- [ ] Know CAP theorem (CP vs AP systems)
- [ ] Can calculate QPS from DAU
- [ ] Can estimate storage requirements
- [ ] Can estimate bandwidth needs
- [ ] Know latency numbers (RAM, SSD, Network)
- [ ] Understand availability (99.9% vs 99.99%)

### Components (Week 2)
- [ ] **Load Balancer**: Round robin, Least connections, IP hash
- [ ] **Cache**: LRU, LFU, TTL policies
- [ ] **Cache Patterns**: Cache-aside, Write-through, Write-behind
- [ ] **Database**: SQL vs NoSQL trade-offs
- [ ] **Sharding**: Range-based, Hash-based, Geographic
- [ ] **Replication**: Master-slave, Master-master
- [ ] **Message Queue**: Pub-sub pattern, When to use
- [ ] **CDN**: How it works, When to use

### Systems Practiced (Week 3-4)
- [ ] **Easy**: URL Shortener (45 min)
- [ ] **Easy**: Pastebin (45 min)
- [ ] **Medium**: Twitter/X (60 min)
- [ ] **Medium**: Instagram (60 min)
- [ ] **Medium**: Rate Limiter (45 min)
- [ ] **Hard**: YouTube/Netflix (60 min)
- [ ] **Hard**: Uber/Lyft (60 min)
- [ ] **Hard**: WhatsApp/Messenger (60 min)

### Mock Interviews
- [ ] Completed at least 5 mock interviews
- [ ] Practiced with timer (45-60 min)
- [ ] Recorded yourself and reviewed
- [ ] Got feedback from peers/mentors
- [ ] Can complete design in time limit

sections.title: During Interview Checklist
sections.body:
### Phase 1: Requirements (5 minutes)

**Functional Requirements:**
- [ ] Asked: "What are the core features?"
- [ ] Asked: "Who are the users?"
- [ ] Asked: "What actions can users perform?"
- [ ] Asked: "Do we need real-time updates?"
- [ ] Confirmed scope with interviewer

**Non-Functional Requirements:**
- [ ] Asked: "How many daily active users?"
- [ ] Asked: "What's the expected QPS?"
- [ ] Asked: "What's the read:write ratio?"
- [ ] Asked: "What latency is acceptable?"
- [ ] Asked: "Is consistency or availability more important?"
- [ ] Asked about geographic distribution

**Constraints:**
- [ ] Asked about budget constraints
- [ ] Asked about technology preferences
- [ ] Confirmed any specific requirements

### Phase 2: Capacity Estimation (5 minutes)

**Traffic Estimation:**
- [ ] Calculated: QPS = (DAU × Actions/day) / 86,400
- [ ] Calculated: Peak QPS = QPS × 2
- [ ] Calculated: Read QPS and Write QPS separately

**Storage Estimation:**
- [ ] Calculated: Total Storage = Items × Size × Replication
- [ ] Considered growth over time (5 years typical)
- [ ] Included metadata overhead

**Bandwidth Estimation:**
- [ ] Calculated: Bandwidth = QPS × Avg Response Size
- [ ] Converted to Mbps or Gbps
- [ ] Considered peak traffic

**Wrote down all numbers clearly!**

### Phase 3: High-Level Design (15-20 minutes)

**Architecture Diagram:**
- [ ] Drew clear boxes and arrows
- [ ] Started with client → load balancer → servers → database
- [ ] Added cache layer (Redis)
- [ ] Added CDN for static content (if needed)
- [ ] Added message queue (if needed)
- [ ] Labeled each component clearly

**Data Flow:**
- [ ] Explained: How does a read request flow?
- [ ] Explained: How does a write request flow?
- [ ] Showed: Where is caching happening?
- [ ] Showed: Where is data stored?

**Components Discussion:**
- [ ] Explained why each component is needed
- [ ] Discussed alternatives considered
- [ ] Asked for feedback from interviewer

### Phase 4: Deep Dive (15-20 minutes)

**Database Design:**
- [ ] Designed schema with tables/collections
- [ ] Showed primary keys and indexes
- [ ] Discussed SQL vs NoSQL choice
- [ ] Explained partitioning/sharding strategy (if applicable)
- [ ] Discussed replication strategy

**API Design:**
- [ ] Defined key APIs (REST endpoints)
- [ ] Showed request/response format
- [ ] Discussed authentication/authorization
- [ ] Mentioned rate limiting

**Scaling Strategy:**
- [ ] Identified bottlenecks in design
- [ ] Proposed solutions for each bottleneck
- [ ] Discussed horizontal scaling approach
- [ ] Mentioned monitoring and metrics

**Trade-offs Discussed:**
- [ ] Consistency vs Availability
- [ ] Latency vs Consistency
- [ ] Cost vs Performance
- [ ] Complexity vs Simplicity

**Edge Cases Handled:**
- [ ] Discussed failure scenarios
- [ ] Mentioned retry mechanisms
- [ ] Discussed data consistency issues
- [ ] Mentioned security considerations

### Phase 5: Wrap-up (5 minutes)

- [ ] Summarized the design
- [ ] Mentioned monitoring and alerting
- [ ] Discussed future improvements
- [ ] Asked if interviewer has questions
- [ ] Asked for feedback
- [ ] Thanked the interviewer

sections.title: Communication Checklist
sections.body:
### During the Interview:
- [ ] Thought out loud (didn't design silently)
- [ ] Asked clarifying questions when unsure
- [ ] Listened to interviewer hints/feedback
- [ ] Checked if interviewer followed my explanation
- [ ] Was open to alternative approaches
- [ ] Spoke clearly and at reasonable pace
- [ ] Used technical terms correctly
- [ ] Drew diagrams as I explained

sections.title: Quick Reference Formulas
sections.body:
**Keep these handy during the interview:**

### Capacity Calculations:
```
QPS = (DAU × Actions per day) / 86,400
Peak QPS = QPS × 2
Write QPS = QPS / (Read:Write Ratio + 1)
Read QPS = Write QPS × Read:Write Ratio

Storage = Users × Data per user × Replication
Storage (with growth) = Storage × Growth Factor × Years

Bandwidth (bps) = QPS × Avg Response Size × 8
Bandwidth (Gbps) = Bandwidth (bps) / 1,000,000,000

Cache Size = Total Data × 0.2 (80-20 rule)
```

### Conversions:
```
1 KB = 1,024 bytes (2^10)
1 MB = 1,048,576 bytes (2^20)
1 GB = 1,073,741,824 bytes (2^30)
1 TB = 2^40 bytes
1 PB = 2^50 bytes

1 day = 86,400 seconds
1 month ≈ 2,592,000 seconds
1 year ≈ 31,536,000 seconds
```

### Latency Numbers:
```
L1 cache: 0.5 ns
L2 cache: 7 ns
RAM: 100 ns
SSD: 150 μs (0.15 ms)
Disk: 10 ms
Network (same datacenter): 0.5 ms
Network (cross-continent): 150 ms
```

sections.title: Common Mistakes to Avoid
sections.body:
- [ ] ✅ Did NOT jump to solution without asking questions
- [ ] ✅ Did NOT skip capacity estimation
- [ ] ✅ Did NOT design silently without explanation
- [ ] ✅ Did NOT over-engineer the solution
- [ ] ✅ Did NOT ignore trade-offs
- [ ] ✅ Did NOT use buzzwords without understanding
- [ ] ✅ Did NOT argue with interviewer
- [ ] ✅ Did NOT give up when stuck

sections.title: Remember
sections.body:
- **There's no perfect solution** - Trade-offs are expected
- **Communication matters** - Explain your thought process
- **It's a conversation** - Not an interrogation
- **Ask questions** - Shows you're thoughtful
- **Think before speaking** - It's OK to pause
- **Be confident** - You've prepared well!

sections.title: Final Confidence Boosters
sections.body:
**I have:**
- [ ] Studied 30+ hours
- [ ] Practiced 10+ systems
- [ ] Done 5+ mock interviews
- [ ] Understand all core concepts
- [ ] Can calculate capacity requirements
- [ ] Can draw clear diagrams
- [ ] Can discuss trade-offs
- [ ] Am ready for this interview!

**Good luck! You've got this! 🚀**
